title: Two Doors
story: A narrow tram has a front door and a back door, and its passengers stand in one line between them. The driver logs every move as a number. A positive number is a passenger with that ticket boarding through the back door and standing behind everyone else. 0 means the passenger nearest the front door gets off; -1 means the passenger nearest the back door gets off. When the tram is empty, a 0 or a -1 was pressed by mistake and nothing happens. Return the tickets of the passengers still on board, from the front door to the back door.

notes: Every move is a ticket number from 1 to 999, 0 or -1.

hints: Passengers leave from both ends of the line, so the line is a deque.
Boarding is PUSH BACK. Getting off is POP FRONT for 0 and POP BACK for -1; both give the ticket that left, which you can SET into a spare variable.
An empty deque cannot give anything: check NOT (tram IS EMPTY) before every POP FRONT or POP BACK. At the end, move what is left into a NEW LIST with POP FRONT.
edgeCases: a door opens on an empty tram
the tram empties and fills again
only the back door is used
only the front door is used
